top_signals.title: Mexico Says Its Troops Sent to Border in Conjunction With US
top_signals.summary: The US and Mexico have jointly deployed military personnel in a border area in Texas as part of “mirror operations,” the Mexican government said Saturday.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: For delicate Crepe, it’s a brave new world
top_signals.summary: After some initial shyness after arriving at ARK, Crepe is becoming more adventurous and has started to explore her environs.
